mapper.insert: INSERT INTO frontend_project_probe (workspace_id, repo_id, status, detector_version, branch, version, creator_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{repoId}, #{status}, #{detectorVersion}, #{branch}, 0, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM frontend_project_probe WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT * FROM frontend_project_probe WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND repo_id = #{repoId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE frontend_project_probe SET status = 'RUNNING', node_id = #{nodeId}, started_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE frontend_project_probe SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', branch = #{branch}, commit_sha = #{commitSha}, candidate_count = #{candidateCount}, error = NULL, finished_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE frontend_project_probe SET status = 'FAILED', error = #{error}, finished_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
